One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the G: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the Gatita models, plus the dashboard for keys, usage, and account state. Every call is authenticated with a bearer key you create in the API dashboard.
Every request needs a bearer key. New ke: Every request needs a bearer key. New keys start with gatita_ and are created and revoked in the API dashboard:
Pass the returned <code>id</code> as the: Pass the returned id as the model field on every request. The dashboard model tester runs this call for you and lists the result.
<strong>Create a key.</strong> Open the: Create a key. Open the API dashboard, go to API Keys, and create one. Copy it immediately — it is shown once.
<strong>Confirm it works.</strong> <code: Confirm it works. GET /v1/models with your key returns every model that key can use.
<strong>Send a request.</strong> <code>P: Send a request. POST /v1/chat/completions with the key in the Authorization header.
<strong>Required.</strong> Conversation: Required. Conversation history; each item is { role, content } with role of system, user, or assistant.
The reply is at <code>choices[0].message: The reply is at choices[0].message.content. A finish_reason of length means max_tokens cut the reply short.
Set <code>\"stream\": true</code> to rec: Set "stream": true to receive the reply incrementally over server-sent events. Each event carries a partial choices[0].delta.content, and the stream ends with data: [DONE].
Paste a key, pick a model from the list: Paste a key, pick a model from the list /v1/models returns for that key, and send a real request. Your key only travels from your browser to the API and is never stored.
Errors use the OpenAI shape: a non-2xx s: Errors use the OpenAI shape: a non-2xx status with { "error": { "message": "...", "type": "...", "code": ... } }. Branch on the HTTP status rather than the message text.
Malformed JSON, missing <code>model</cod: Malformed JSON, missing model or messages, or an invalid parameter.
Missing or invalid API key — check the <: Missing or invalid API key — check the Authorization header.
Unknown endpoint or model id. Confirm id: Unknown endpoint or model id. Confirm ids against GET /v1/models.
Limits come from your plan, are tracked: Limits come from your plan, are tracked per key, and are shown live in the dashboard's Usage tab.
Something missing or out of date? The <a: Something missing or out of date? The <a href="https://discord.gg/H4AxnP6CfS" target="_blank" rel="noopener" >Gatita Discord</a > is the fastest route.
A full key is shown exactly once, at cre: A full key is shown exactly once, at creation. Test it against GET /v1/models to confirm it works and to see which models it can reach.
One document, two parts: the rules for u: One document, two parts: the rules for using Gatita, and what happens to your data. Both apply to Gatita Ask, this dashboard, and the public API.
Only you can read your chats. Nothing is: Only you can read your chats. Nothing is visible to other users unless you create a share link yourself.
Your chats, files, prompts, and response: Your chats, files, prompts, and responses are not used to train or fine-tune models, build datasets, or profile you.
No personal information is sold, rented,: No personal information is sold, rented, or traded. Revenue comes from optional paid API plans, not from your data.
No advertising or cross-site tracking co: No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. Only storage that login, security, and rate limits actually require.
Delete a chat or a message instantly. De: Delete a chat or a message instantly. Delete your account from settings. All of your data is gone after a 7-day grace window.
API keys are shown once. We never store: API keys are shown once. We never store the full value, so it cannot be recovered. Keys can only be revoked and replaced.
By creating an account or making a reque: By creating an account or making a request you agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use Gatita. You must be at least 13 years old, and if you are under 18 you need a parent or guardian's permission. Using the service on behalf of an organisation means you have authority to bind that organisation, and "you" includes it.
Gatita is a beta AI chat service and an: Gatita is a beta AI chat service and an OpenAI-compatible API. Model output may be incomplete, incorrect, biased, outdated, or unsuitable for your situation, and it may change or be withdrawn at any time. Verify anything consequential before relying on it, especially for legal, medical, financial, safety, employment, or other high-impact decisions.
You are responsible for your account, pa: You are responsible for your account, password, and every action taken under your session. Use a unique strong password, do not share your login, and keep your API keys secret. Tell us promptly if you think an account or key has been compromised.
To protect the service and its users we: To protect the service and its users we may apply browser verification, rate limits, abuse detection, temporary restrictions, and strikes. These measures are applied to signed-out guests as well as accounts.
The chat product is free. The API has op: The chat product is free. The API has optional paid tiers (such as Plus and Pro) with higher request, rate, and token limits. Paid plans renew until cancelled and can be cancelled at any time from the dashboard; cancellation stops future billing and takes effect at the end of the current period.
Charges are made to the payment method o: Charges are made to the payment method on file at the start of each period. Prices, currency, and included limits are shown before you confirm any change.
Because paid tiers unlock additional cap: Because paid tiers unlock additional capacity rather than content, used portions are generally not refundable. Unused time may be refunded where required by law, or at Gatita's discretion.
Plan limits can be adjusted for abuse pr: Plan limits can be adjusted for abuse prevention, capacity, or operational reasons. We will tell you before a change affects a plan you have already paid for.
Prices exclude taxes where the law requi: Prices exclude taxes where the law requires them to be added. You are responsible for taxes arising from your use, other than taxes on Gatita's own income.
You may not use Gatita to request, creat: You may not use Gatita to request, create, upload, share, transmit, or facilitate anything illegal, abusive, exploitative, or harmful. Prohibited uses include:

Credential theft, phishing, impersonatio: Credential theft, phishing, impersonation, or fraud.
Ban evasion, striping, or attempts to by: Ban evasion, striping, or attempts to bypass safety or security controls.

We may remove content, restrict features: We may remove content, restrict features, strike accounts, revoke API keys, or suspend access when we reasonably believe these rules have been broken.

You are responsible for what you submit: You are responsible for what you submit and must have the right to share it. Do not submit other people's personal information, or material you obtained in confidence, unless you are authorised to do so.
As between you and Gatita, you own your: As between you and Gatita, you own your input and, subject to these Terms, may use the generated output for any lawful purpose. Gatita claims no ownership of your chats or uploads.
Output is produced algorithmically and m: Output is produced algorithmically and may not be unique. Gatita does not guarantee that any output is free of third-party rights, accurate, or fit for a particular purpose, and you are responsible for reviewing it before relying on it.

Third-party links and sources are provid: Third-party links and sources are provided as-is. Gatita does not control them and is not responsible for their content or practices.
We may suspend or terminate access if yo: We may suspend or terminate access if you repeatedly break these Terms, abuse the service, attempt to bypass security controls, or create risk for other users or the platform. Gatita is provided \"as is\" and \"as av: Gatita is provided "as is" and "as available". We may update these Terms as the service: We may update these Terms as the service changes. The effective date and version at the top of this page always show which version applies. For material changes we will provide reasonable notice in the product or on this page, and ask you to accept them before they take effect. Continuing to use Gatita after a change means you accept it.
These Terms are governed by the laws app: These Terms are governed by the laws applicable where Gatita is published, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Nothing removes protections you have under the mandatory law where you live.

We may notify you in-product or by email: We may notify you in-product or by email. You agree that email and in-product notices are valid delivery.
These Terms, the Privacy Policy, and the: These Terms, the Privacy Policy, and the API terms are the entire agreement between you and Gatita about the service.
This policy says what Gatita collects, w: This policy says what Gatita collects, why, who sees it, how long it is kept, and what you can do about it. If a practice here ever changes in a way that affects you, this page changes first.
Chat privacy is the default, not a paid: Chat privacy is the default, not a paid upgrade. Gatita collects the minimum needed to run a chat service, keeps chats private by default, never sells personal information, and never uses your content for training or product enhancement.
Gatita also aims to be efficient: we lim: Gatita also aims to be efficient: we limit energy and storage use, avoid tracking we do not need, and prefer renewable energy where we make infrastructure choices.
Email address, display name, password ha: Email address, display name, password hash and salt, and account creation, update, and last-login timestamps. Your display name is used to address you in the product.
Hashed session tokens, session expiry, u: Hashed session tokens, session expiry, user-agent text, hashed IP-related data, a guest identifier, browser verification results, and request metadata used to stop spam and automated abuse.

Per-minute message events and Deep resea: Per-minute message events and Deep research events, so rate and daily limits can be enforced.
Key names, key hashes and prefixes, crea: Key names, key hashes and prefixes, creation and expiry dates, last-used timestamps, request and token counts, and the model or endpoint label for a request. These are used for limits, analytics, and abuse prevention. Full key values are never stored.
Session token, guest ID, selected model: Session token, guest ID, selected model and personality, thinking and research settings, notification preference, and interface preferences. This lives in your browser, not in an ad profile.

To debug reliability, keep the service s: To debug reliability, keep the service secure, and meet legal obligations.
Processing needed to give you the servic: Processing needed to give you the service you asked for: accounts, chats, files, API responses, and billing.
Security, fraud and abuse prevention, ra: Security, fraud and abuse prevention, rate limiting, service reliability, and answering support requests.
Optional browser notifications, and any: Optional browser notifications, and any optional processing where we ask you first. You can withdraw consent at any time in account settings.
Retaining limited records where required: Retaining limited records where required, responding to valid legal process, and meeting tax and accounting duties.
Gatita uses local storage and a small nu: Gatita uses local storage and a small number of cookies. A browser security check may set, read, or compute challenge tokens to confirm a request is legitimate. To answer you, your messages, the releva: To answer you, your messages, the relevant chat context, uploaded content, selected settings, and session details are sent to Gatita servers and processed by the model you selected. That processing happens to serve your request only. It is not used for training, fine-tuning, analytics datasets, advertising, profiling, resale, or service enhancement.
Context is limited to what is needed for: Context is limited to what is needed for the conversation. Temporary chats are not saved to your account at all.
If you turn on Research, Deep research,: If you turn on Research, Deep research, or Auto web check, Gatita may generate search queries, send them to a search provider, fetch result pages, and include snippets in the model's context. The pages you see cited under Sources may therefore have received a request from Gatita rather than from your device. All of these tools are off by default and can be disabled in the model picker.
Chats are private unless you create a sh: Chats are private unless you create a share link. A shared chat can be read by anyone holding the link until you disable sharing or delete the chat. Share links use random tokens, so they cannot be guessed.
Gatita relies on a small number of proce: Gatita relies on a small number of processors, each limited to a specific function:
Runs the backend that stores chats, file: Runs the backend that stores chats, files, and account data.
Processes paid API plan payments. Gatita: Processes paid API plan payments. Gatita never receives your full card number.
Sends transactional messages such as sec: Sends transactional messages such as security notices and deletion confirmations.
Used only when you enable Research, Deep: Used only when you enable Research, Deep research, or Auto web check.
Until you delete them or close your acco: Until you delete them or close your account.
Removed from normal access promptly; res: Removed from normal access promptly; residual backups age out on their normal cycle.
Finalised 7 days after you schedule it. Signing back in before then cancels it.
Limited retention, only as long as neede: Limited retention, only as long as needed to investigate, prevent recurrence, and meet legal duties.
While the key is active, then limited re: While the key is active, then limited retention for billing and abuse prevention.
Until you clear it, sign out and clear s: Until you clear it, sign out and clear site data, or the browser evicts it.
Gatita uses privacy-minded security: has: Gatita uses privacy-minded security: hashed passwords with per-account salts, hashed session tokens, origin checks, browser security challenges, rate limiting, scoped API keys that are stored hashed, and least-privilege access to production data.
No internet service can promise perfect: No internet service can promise perfect security. If a breach meaningfully affects your personal data, we will notify affected users and the relevant authority as required by law, and describe what happened and what we changed.
Gatita and its processors may process da: Gatita and its processors may process data outside your country. Where data is transferred, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or equivalent protections, and we limit transfers to what the service needs.
Depending on where you live, you may hav: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, export, or restrict processing of your personal data, to object to certain processing, to withdraw consent, and to complain to a supervisory authority.
Delete chats and messages from the inter: Delete chats and messages from the interface, disable research tools, turn off notifications, clear local browser data, revoke API keys, and schedule account deletion. Available from the account dock or dashboard.
Email us to request a copy of your data,: Email us to request a copy of your data, a correction, or erasure. We may ask you to confirm your account first.
API strikes and account restrictions can: API strikes and account restrictions can be appealed through support.
Gatita is not directed at children under: Gatita is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If you believe a child has submitted personal information, contact us and we will review and delete it where appropriate. Users aged 13-17 are recommended to use the service with a parent or guardian.
Responses are generated by machine-learn: Responses are generated by machine-learning models. Some automated decisions directly affect your access. For example, rate limits, strikes, and bans are applied to protect the service and its users. They are always appealable through support.
Model output itself is not a binding dec: Model output itself is not a binding decision, and it should not be the sole basis for decisions about a person.
Gatita does not respond to Do Not Track: Gatita does not respond to Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control as a mechanism for ads, because Gatita has no advertising. Optional notifications can be turned off directly in account settings.
We may update this policy as the service: We may update this policy as the service changes. The effective date and version at the top always show which version applies. If a change materially affects your rights, we will provide notice in the product or by email before it takes effect.
These terms apply to the Gatita API in a: These terms apply to the Gatita API in addition to everything above. If they conflict with the Terms of Service, the API terms win for API use.
Every request carries a bearer key creat: Every request carries a bearer key created in the dashboard. Full key values are shown exactly once and are stored only as a hash, so a lost key cannot be recovered. If you lose a key, you must revoke it and create another. Keys are confidential: keep them out of public repositories, client-side code, logs, screenshots, and support messages.
Per-minute and per-day request limits an: Per-minute and per-day request limits and Deep research limits are enforced per key and per account, and are reported live in the dashboard. Repeated 429 responses mean you are over a limit: back off rather than retrying immediately.
Prompts, files, and context sent to API: Prompts, files, and context sent to API endpoints are handled under exactly the same commitments as Gatita Ask: no training, no sale, no product-enhancement use. If you send personal data through the API, you are the controller for it and you are responsible for having a lawful basis to do so.
Do not resell raw API access, circumvent: Do not resell raw API access, circumvent rate limits, share one key across unrelated parties, or use the API to build a competing hosted inference product without written permission. Strikes apply to keys as well as to chats: on the free tier an active strike blocks API access, while Plus and Pro keys keep access with strike bypass enabled.
For privacy, security, account, data, or: For privacy, security, account, data, or legal questions, including access and deletion requests, reach us at:
For security-related issues, please subm: For security-related issues, please submit a report through the contact email. Security reports are welcome and appreciated. Please include reproduction steps and give us reasonable time to fix issues before public disclosure.
These Terms govern your use of Gatita As: These Terms govern your use of Gatita Ask, the API dashboard at api.html, and the public API. Using the service means you accept them.
<strong>Share links are public to anyone: Share links are public to anyone holding them. A shared chat can be read by its holder until you disable sharing or delete the chat. If a link leaks, please rotate it. There is no way to know who has already saved a copy.
Gatita does <strong>not</strong> use you: Gatita does not use your chats, prompts, uploaded files, account data, API traffic, or generated responses to train or fine-tune AI models, build or sell datasets, create derived profiles, advertise to you, or improve the product beyond operating and securing it. Data is processed only to answer your request, keep your history, enforce limits, protect the platform, and meet legal obligations.
A <strong>strike</strong> is a formal wa: A strike is a formal warning recorded against an account or API key for a policy violation such as automated abuse or an attempt to bypass safety controls. A strike can pause chat or API access for a period, and on paid tiers may leave access enabled while the strike is active.
<strong>We do not sell or share your per: We do not sell or share your personal information for advertisers. We disclose data only to the processors listed below, in response to valid legal process, or when required to protect users and the service.
The models your key can use are whatever: The models your key can use are whatever GET /v1/models returns for it. Availability depends on your plan, can change without notice, and is never guaranteed by a list published in the docs. Requesting a model your key does not have returns an error, not a fallback.
The same account powers Gatita Ask and t: The same account powers Gatita Ask and the API dashboard. We forward you to the sign-in form and bring you straight back.
Sessions live in this browser. Signing o: Sessions live in this browser. Signing out clears the token locally.
